newsitem.title: POLAND: SOCCER-WIDZEW LODZ V ATLETICO MADRID LATEST.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-WIDZEW LODZ V ATLETICO MADRID LATEST.

text.p: Milinko Pantic gave Atletico Madrid a 1-0 in the 24th minute of their European Cup Champions' League Group B match against Widzew Lodz on Wednesday.
Diego Simeone scored in the 32nd minute to put Atletico Madrid 2-0 up against Widzew Lodz.
Marek Citko scored for Widzew Lodz in the 45th minute to cut Atletico Madrid's lead to 2-1.
Simeone scored his second goal in the 60th minute to put Atletico Madrid 3-1 up against Widzew Lodz.
Kiko scored for Atletico Madrid in the 61st minute to make it 4-1 against Widzew Lodz.
